First dyno!!! Scary wall.

Short beta: 
For the jump, generate momentum in an oval shape. Jug is facing left so you want to travel a bit right to get it. If you grab on the right spot, you should be able to somewhat one arm hang and get the other hand on. 

Same beta as the rest until the jump move to the crimp. Wasnt able to get it by jumping on the right foot, so switched feet, flagging right leg and was able to hit the crimp that way. That being said I had to drag to reach so if you’re shorter than me you might have to use the higher foot and rock over. 

Such a fun climb, would’ve been 5 stars but beta is too easily broken with even an avg span.
